title: Machine learning on routine blood biomarkers predicts age-related hearing loss
summary: From 542 NHANES participants (271 cases, 271 controls), comparing 113 algorithm combinations selected a glmBoost plus Stepglm model with AUC 0.948 in training and 0.893 and 0.945 in two internal sets. In 92 patients from Chongqing People's Hospital it kept AUC 0.839 (accuracy 77.2%). HbA1c, MCV and blood glucose were the top SHAP features. The external cohort is small and from one center.
ai_technology: Selection among 113 machine learning algorithm combinations (glmBoost plus Stepglm) with SHAP

evidence.tested: Two internal validation sets and an external single-center cohort (n=92).
evidence.unknown: Prospective performance and clinical benefit are not reported; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Selected the model and ranked predictive biomarkers.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata and author affiliations from Crossref for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
